our_interpretation: The narrow factual component is that reduced May–June fees lowered Anthropic's charges relative to the full contracted monthly rate.
The stronger allegation is that preferential pricing artificially improved reported economics, rather than simply charging less while less capacity was delivered.
The target period is May–June 2026, the ramp-up months identified in the surrounding text.
Lower aggregate fees alone do not establish a below-market unit price, improper accounting, or an arrangement intended to manufacture profit.
criteria.support_condition: Contract and delivery records show preferential pricing beyond an ordinary capacity ramp, and expense records establish that it caused an artificial reduction in the reported quarter's costs.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Records show that charges followed delivered capacity on ordinary terms and that the alleged preferential cost suppression did not occur.
